title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode15 Let's All Sing!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, I'm finished with the dishes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku. Would you mind wiping down the tables next?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, hi An. I see Kohane is with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys aren't closing up, are you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We can come back another day if you are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Akito and Toya are here too. We're still open for a little while, don't worry.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome to stop by any time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's not often I see all four of you together, though.
What's up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, we were planning on practicing at the restaurant today, but one of my dad's old buddies showed up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the park we use for practice is packed with people today, so we were wondering if it would be all right to use your stage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. Feel free to use it as much as you need.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry for asking out of the blue like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's no trouble at all.
On the contrary, it's great to see you all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's get to it, then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. I'll handle the rhythm for this first song.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ready? One, two, three, four!
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. They sure seem to be doing well together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They sure do. I'm looking forward to seeing how much they grow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If they keep this up, they'll achieve their dream in no time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't you think you should pick up the tempo a bit while Kohane is singing her part?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Why? If I start to lead into my part of the song, it'll help boost the peak in the second half.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No way. You should wait until this spot here, then increase the tempo. That'll get a better reaction from the crowd.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That may be true, but layering the sounds early will help give Kohane's part an extra kick.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Please calm down, you two...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, Kohane, but this problem is between me and Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, maybe Kohane should be the one to decide how to handle Kohane's part, yeah?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? Me? Well, I think both of your ideas would work, so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree that both ideas would work well.
Making a decision isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, dear. Are they having a difference of opinion?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It would seem so. That's not necessarily a bad thing, though.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I know. Why don't we see what Miku and MEIKO have to say about it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not a bad idea. Letting the audience decide would definitely be the fastest way to make you realize I'm right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why are you always like this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Miku! MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito and I are both going to sing a verse real quick. Would you tell us which one you think would go better with Kohane's part?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We get to be judges? Sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Great. Miku and MEIKO are sure to give us an impartial decision on which of us has the better idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All right then, Akito. Let's settle this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh? You don't think you can actually beat me, do you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, it looks like the whole squad is here!
What's up? Are you singing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, we're in the middle of a serious debate.
You two can wait until—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This looks fun! Can we join you?
I've been wanting to sing with you guys for a while!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, um... Why not! Let's all sing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I thought we were going to sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Rin and Len look like they both really want to join us. We can settle our little debate later, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hurray! This is going to be great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were actually just talking about how much we wanted to sing with you and the others, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All right, fine...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What should we sing? Is there anything you all want to sing together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, and I'll be the DJ!
This looks like fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane, Toya, is there anything you want to sing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm, I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If Len is going to be the DJ, what about that song the four of us sang last time?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like Rin and Len showing up tossed a bit of a wrench into Akito's and An's argument.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, they sure have great timing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't think they knew to come just now, do you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows?
